thread:
michelle: Quick sync: finalizing Playground chat UX tweaks — streaming render, stop/regenerate controls, token indicator, and prompt library entrypoint. Short bullets please.

samir: For streaming, prefer a single growing response node with micro-flushes at sentence boundaries. Less DOM churn and feels live.

aldo: yep single node. Impl note: batch DOM updates ~300-500ms. Also don't auto-scroll if user scrolled up. Add a "Follow output" toggle.

jia: A11y: streamed content must be aria-live="polite" and announce only final sentence or when user focuses the response.

noah: Stop/regenerate: Show a clear stop button while streaming (visible + keyboard accessible). After finish swap to regenerate icon. Esc to stop, Alt+R for regenerate (avoid Ctrl/Cmd+R).

samir: UI idea: floating right-side pill that shows "Streaming..." + X to stop; becomes circular regenerate button when done. Mobile: keep pill touch-sized.

jia: Ensure focus order stable when button appears. Buttons should have accessible labels and focus rings.

michelle: Token counter: compact pill bottom-right of card showing total tokens. Click to expand popover with breakdown (prompt/response/estimated). During streaming mark as "estimated".

aldo: update counts at chunk flush or ~500ms to save CPU. Don't announce every update to screen readers.

noah: Prompt library: inline shelf toggle in composer (icon + label on desktop, bottom-sheet on mobile). Shortcut: "/" opens quick-pick. Add favorites and fuzzy search.

jia: Prompt list must be keyboard navigable (list/listitem) and previews aria-hidden unless focused. Provide a "Skip to prompts" link for SR users.

michelle: Action items: Samir mock floating pill + token placement (EOD Thu). Aldo: prototype autoscroll toggle + throttling (Fri). Jia: accessibility checklist (Wed). Noah: prompt shelf search/favorites spec (Fri). Thanks!

samir: ack
